title: Personal hosting asks its meters: published Practices, guests per personal Event and people per Journey
detail: PHASE 2 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). TARGET: merged before 2026-11-24, because pricing_settings.beta_grace ends 2026-12-01 and every count limit enforces that day with no deploy. practice_publish and journey_enrollees are display-only on the personal axis; event_guests is new (LIVE-750 sets the number). Each write path asks memberWithinLeadershipAllowance. Granted Crew gets the same host kit as billed Crew, never unlimited.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=d+"/"+f.name;if(f.isDirectory()){if(f.name!=="node_modules")walk(p,o)}else if(/\.tsx?$/.test(f.name)&&!/\.test\./.test(f.name))o.push(p)}return o};const src=[...walk("lib"),...walk("app")].filter((f)=>!f.startsWith("lib/pricing/")).map((f)=>[f,r(f)]);const usedAt=(k,seam)=>src.some(([f,s])=>s.includes(JSON.stringify(k).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(39)))&&seam.test(s));const seam=/memberWithinLeadershipAllowance\(/;const miss=["practice_publish","journey_enrollees","event_guests"].filter((k)=>!usedAt(k,seam));if(miss.length)fail("personal write paths never ask: "+miss.join(","));console.log("ok: personal hosting caps are asked at write")'
